 I love any excuse to give a gift and make someone smile. So even though I hate the cold, I welcome the fast-approaching holiday season. I can’t wait to pick out all the different presents, wrap them, and stash them away until it’s time to leave them under the miniature fake tree my roommates and I pull out each winter. And sitting beneath that faux fir are sure to be some hand-selected K-beauty gifts I love and want to share with my loved ones.
 I’m sure you’re dying to know what’s on my shopping list, so I decided to be super-generous this year and share all the K-beauty sets, kits, and products I think are worth gifting to friends and family (or maybe even yourself). Don’t worry, I won’t be upset if you copy my homework — I’ll be delighted that you trusted my judgment.
 So you want to shop for K-beauty gifts like a Korean beauty editor …

 Lazy Skinscience Lazy Essentialist Set
 $108
 $108
 When you lift the lid from a jar of Lazy Skinscience’s Double Duty, you’ll see a brightening jelly serum on one side and a plush, silky moisturizer on the other. I’m always skeptical when it comes to two-in-one products — what if I like one much more than the other? As someone who has tested dozens, if not hundreds, of skin-care products, I’m not easily impressed. But I’m thrilled to report that I am head over heels for both formulas; my dry, moisture-greedy skin drinks them up and feels hydrated, smooth, and happy all day and night. I’m trying some other moisturizers right now, but I’m itching to finish those and crack open a new Double Duty as soon as possible.
 I can see my mom loving the duo too, so she’ll be getting her own jar this winter. And to make the gift feel extra-special for the holidays, you can purchase this set, which comes with Double Duty and a beautiful limited-edition bag inspired by traditional Korean good-fortune pouches.

 Skin1004 Madagascar Centella Double Cleansing Duo
 $32
 $32
 To love someone is to want them to have clean skin, am I right? And I know you’re tired of hearing it, but let me say it again: If you want to truly rid your skin of makeup, SPF, and pollutants, you’ve got to double cleanse. Skin1004 ’s cleansers are some of the best on the market, and the cleansing oil in particular is a must-have for me — it doesn’t leave a greasy film and gets all the blackheads and sebaceous filaments out of my pores when I massage the formula into my skin.

 I am addicted to the scent of these products. Sure, the scrub makes my skin feel smoother than sateen sheets, and the body butter has this whipped texture that spreads like a dream, but it’s their warm, woody, comforting scent that keeps me coming back again and again. The fragrance features notes of patchouli, sandalwood, and vetiver and reminds me of someone or something I must have loved as a child. It’s so nostalgic; I’d be happy if I could smell like that all the time.

 Nonfiction Table Guest Holiday Set
 $62
 $62
 Nonfiction is one of the coolest fragrance brands out of South Korea. I haven’t met a scent from the perfumery that I didn’t like, and the Lower East Side store that opened earlier this year is worth a visit, even if it’s just to gawk at the enviable décor. I find the home scents just as enchanting, and I want my apartment to smell like Table Guest (a verdant, earthy mixture of black currant, ivy leaf, and patchouli) whenever I host my friends. As a result, I can’t get this set out of my head; not only does it include a Table Guest room spray, it has a candle that resembles a crescent moon. The rest of the fun-shaped candles feature other festive scents, and I’m looking forward to trying them all when I gift them to myself.

 Elorea The Discovery Set
 $210
 $210
 Elorea (whose name is a portmanteau of “elements of Korea”) is a perfume house that draws inspiration from the peninsula’s rich history, culture, and traditions. For example, the brand’s first collection was made up of four scents for the four elements represented on the South Korean flag: heaven, earth, water, and fire. Another favorite of mine is Haenyo, an aquatic fragrance inspired by the female divers of Jeju Island, who have been harvesting food from the ocean floor (sans oxygen mask!) for generations. The discovery set allows you to explore 16 scents and comes with a voucher for a full-size 50-ml. bottle for when you’re ready to take the plunge.
